summary: Ship Liberation Serif (Times New Roman counterpart) with the client
author: pm
body:
Ship Liberation Serif with the client as the open counterpart to Times New Roman, the way Wine Tahoma stands in for Tahoma. The user's ruling (2026-11-24): "We can ship liberation serif with the client as well".

| measured | result |
|---|---|
| advance widths, Times New Roman vs Liberation Serif 2.1.5, 4 styles x 11/12/14/18/28 px | identical in all 20 cases (PIL, `.claude/scratch/fonts/compare.py`) |
| licence | SIL OFL 1.1 (release LICENSE file) |

Staged as `staged/client/fonts/liberation_serif_{regular,bold,italic,bold_italic}.ttf`, plus `liberation-serif-OFL-1.1.txt`. They come from the official release `liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz` (github.com/liberationfonts). No client code uses them yet.

**Done when:** the four TTFs and the licence are committed in `staged/client/fonts/` and deployed to `game/client/fonts/`.

Source: user message, 2026-11-24; comparison image `.claude/scratch/fonts/times_vs_liberation.png`.
